svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 01 · Santa Barbara · 01/12 Storke Tower (Legendary)
svg.desc: The carillon tower at the middle of campus. You can find your way home by it. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
